GraceTechnology.Runtime: Pinned stable Rust 1.98.0 native host; future plugin isolation may use Wasmtime, native processes, or provider processes behind versioned contracts.
GraceTechnology.Framework: Cargo workspace with a generic kernel crate, reference plugin crate, and proving-slice demo.
GraceTechnology.TestingStack: cargo test acceptance suites, persistent S0 and S1 proving slices, rustfmt, Clippy, rustdoc, and GRACE 4 lint.
GraceTechnology.Observability: Typed trajectory records and independent diagnostic or domain events; trace context is not authority.

OperationalConstraints.Constraint: Prefer standard library and existing workspace patterns before adding dependencies.
CI logic must remain runnable through repository-owned commands rather than existing only in workflow YAML.
Tests must not require live model providers, browser services, or production credentials.
